Misaru_Miśra
or Miśaru of Mithilā.
3rd quarter of the 15th cent.; ascribes his work to his patron Lachimādevi, wife of Candra Siṃha, younger step-brother of the Mithilā king Bhairavasiṃhadeva alias Harinārāyaṇa; diff. from Misaruka, a. of Nyāyadīpikā. See Kane, HDS. I. ii. Sn. 100; also S. C. Vidyabhushan, HIL. p. 460.
